answer: Re-attestations are stored in wander and willow lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 16 epochs, which means holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the echo graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 759 impostors cost 174 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
